## 5fdbbb5a53ef

**Finding: reproduced positional-template shortcut; target left unchanged.** I
selected the first 32 easy-band draws whose galleries were exactly 2 top panels
by 2 left panels. All 32 inputs were unique, yet every reference output was the
same fixed 2x2 template `[[8,3],[6,0]]`. A model can therefore map the common
layout directly to a constant answer without reading panel contents.

For an executable witness, I generated seed 0/sample 3 and swapped the interiors
of the two top-gallery panels. The mutation passes the audited generator's
`self_check` with no messages. Supported Racket execution changes the answer to
`[[3,8],[0,6]]`; the fixed-position rival remains `[[8,3],[6,0]]`. This proves a
shortcut in the sampled subset and a validator-accepted counterexample. It does
not claim every gallery dimension has a fixed output.

Evidence: `checks/audit/5fdbbb5a53ef/evidence.json`, `generation.json`,
`counterexample_input.json`, `counterexample_racket.json`, and `rival.json`.
Audited generator SHA-256 is
`341c8b1e8356ca8b67b6e6a2fc0b465dcb4fa5d0b9d1c6b4f215ded3d7827063`;
executed rule hash is `b12aeca2f818`. No source for this audit target was changed.
